page0.text:
"Yeah, I agree with your take on it.
I can't let that Shadow run around. I don't know the mage behind it, but they've got nerve running amok on my land."

page1.text:
"Are we going to keep the truce, then?"
"Of course. We don't have the luxury of fighting until we eliminate that Shadow."

page2.text:
The conversation wraps up smoothly.
When lunch break started, I went to Tohsaka's Class A and brought her to the roof.
Then, I kicked things off by suggesting that we do something about the Shadow, but Tohsaka turned out to be even more determined than I am.

page3.text: "So, what's the plan? Should we patrol together tonight, or split up and search?"

page4.text:
"Let me think...I think we should split up roles.
You keep patrolling at night. I want you to go over any place you find suspicious as a mage or that stands out to Saber with a fine-toothed comb.
While you do that out in the open, I'm going to go after Zouken."

page5.text: "...Zouken Matou? What does he have to do with the Shadow?"

page6.text:
"No idea. I think he's a weak lead because he's scared of it too, but something about him bothers me.
...Plus, we still can't ignore him even without the Shadow. He's been doing all kinds of shady stuff like controlling Caster's corpse or turning Shinji into a Master even though he isn't even a mage."

page7.text: "Oh. Yeah, now that you mention it, we teamed up to deal with Caster for similar reasons. We can't just let the old man run wild now."

page8.text: "Yeah. We'll deal with the Shadow once we clean up the mess around it. Even if you find it, just observe from a distance. We shouldn't fight it until we can do that on our own terms."

page9.text: "OK. So what are you going to do, specifically? Do you know where Zouken is?"

page10.text:
"Huh...? Um, yeah. I don't know exactly where he is now, but I can go straight to the Matou estate. Our families are connected, so I'm better for this job than you anyway."
Tohsaka lays out her plan in a lighthearted tone.
The details are anything but light, though.

page11.text:
"You'll go to the Matous' place!? That's dropping straight into the enemy's home base, you know!"
"I know that. What are you so shocked for? I'm not going to fight. I'm just going to scout out their camp."

page12.text:
"Wha—And what are you gonna do if Zouken ambushes you!?
I'm not letting you go there by yourself. I'm coming too, so don't be reckless—"

page13.text:
"You're the reckless one, stupid.
I said that I have a connection to the Matous, remember? I know their magecraft and I figured out how strong Zouken is yesterday. To be clear, Zouken isn't much of an enemy.
He uses most of his magical energy just to maintain his body, and he has no direct means of attack."

page14.text:
"In fact, if Zouken wants a straight up fight, it would be to my advantage. Without Shinji as a Master, he's hardly a threat.
Leave the old-fashioned mage duels to me. You should go physically gather intel for us."

page15.text:
"...Mrgh."
I can't argue with her when she puts it like that.
Tohsaka has Archer with her, so there's no point being overprotective.

page16.text:
"...All right. I'll let you deal with Zouken. Saber and I will look for the Shadow."
"Okay, thanks... Also, Emiya, I wanted to ask. Sakura's really staying at your place, right?"

page17.text:
"? Yeah, she's been sleeping over. Why?"
"No, never mind. I'm relieved to hear it.
It would get awkward if I ran into her at the Matou house. She doesn't know anything."

page18.text:
"Oh, right... You're really considerate, Tohsaka. I'm surprised."
"S-stop looking at me like it's a huge shocker. What do you take me for?"

page19.text:
"Well, if you have to ask..."
A human hurricane who arrives with a crash and leaves with a bang, I guess.

page20.text:
"...Hmph. I don't care what you think.
Anyway, I'll deal with the Matou problem, so just behave the rest of the day."

page21.text:
"Roger that. I'll use the daytime to train with Saber, in the meantime."
I stand up and head for the exit.
Lunchtime is almost over, so I'd better get back to class.

page22.text:
"Later, Tohsaka. Let's meet up here tomorrow."
"Okay. We'll tell each other what we found out.
Oh, but Emiya?"
Tohsaka's lips curl into a smile.

page23.text:
...
...When she smiles like that, it never means anything good.

page24.text:
I make a beeline for the door, a terrible feeling building in my stomach.
"Maybe you shouldn't spend all your time training.
Isn't there something else you could be doing?
Liiiike, taking better care of the girl living under the same roof?"
Unfortunately, I was still within her attack range.

page25.text:
"W-what the hell are you talking about!?
S-Sakura and I aren't like that! I'm just keeping an eye on her while Shinji is acting out—"

page26.text:
"Oh, I was only saying that you should let Saber rest. Wow, Emiya. So Sakura comes to mind first when I mention girls, huh?"
She smirks.

page27.text:
"Ah. Er. Uh..."
My face is beet red.

page28.text:
"Just kidding, man. Did you like that bit of payback?"
"...Only a nutcase would like the way you treat me."

page29.text:
My shoulders droop.
I feel as slack as a marionette with its strings cut.

page30.text:
"So that's your weakness, Emiya. I guess that joke was in bad taste."
"Hmph! You're the one with bad taste! I'm leaving."

page31.text:
"Sure, go on ahead. I'm going to stay here and laugh at you a little longer."
"Nngh! Damn it, see you tomorrow, Tohsaka!"

page32.text:
I slam the door behind me and leave the roof.
...Damn it.
She only came here to push my buttons.
